findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "holidays_countries" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Use before calling /v1/holidays or /v1/holidays/check to discover supported country codes: returns every country Nager.Date covers (~100), each with countryCode…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: hn · Private data: time_now, holiday_check · Public sink: time_convert.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: hn · Private data: time_now, holiday_check · Public sink: time_convert

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
